title: Estimation
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:42 AM

Estimation

Purpose

This component allows you to estimate meter reading results automatically in the case of missing meter readings or implausible
consumption.

Implementation considerations

This component is optional.

Process Implausible Meter Reading Results Using Machine
Learning

Machine learning can be used to process implausible meter reading results.

In this context, the machine learning functionality covers the following areas:

e Provision of training and apply-relevant datasets to access and utilize machine learning-relevant information for
implausible meter reading results

e Enabling of the Intelligent Scenario Lifecycle Management (ISLM) to define an active predictive model for the predictive
scenario UTI_MR_IMPLAUSIBLE.

e Determination of the release confidence values for implausible meter reading results.
e Automatic release of implausible meter reading results, based on the release confidence against a given threshold.

e Display the release confidence in the Fiori app Resolve Implausible Meter Readings. The relevant documentation can be
found at |help.sap.com/utilities » Product Assistance (SAP S/4HANA 1909 or more recent) » Apps for SAP Utilities
Resolve Implausible Meter Readings

For more information, see the chapter Machine Learning for SAP Utilities.

Use

Reversing meter reading deletes all objects generated during creation of meter reading orders and entry of meter reading results:

e Meter reading orders

e Meter reading results (optional)

e Billing orders
